headline: Expanse Fighting Renews; Colonials Hold Bulk of Map
war_summary: Fighting in the Weathered Expanse has burned through the night. The district, counted four Warden works, two Colonial and three unclaimed at the last edition, now reports seven Warden works, two unclaimed and none Colonial, with three events in the past two hours and fifty-six across the day; losses there stand at 8,096 Colonial and 12,062 Warden for the day and are still climbing fast. Callahan's Passage has roused again: eight Warden works against one Colonial and one unclaimed, thirty-five events filed in the day and fresh entries as this edition closed, the day's rolls there at 11,076 Colonial and 12,173 Warden. Palantine Berm has tightened to six Warden works against one Colonial, twenty-three events in six hours. Stlican Shelf now reads eight Colonial to one Warden, Stonecradle eight to one, and the Nevish Line holds at seven Warden against one Colonial. A fresh spate of activity is noted at Scouts Jest in Callum's Cape. Colonials hold the great majority of works on the board, roughly seven in ten of the four hundred and thirty-six counted. No victory is declared on this, the five hundred and fifteenth day; thirty-four victory towns remain the mark.
